name: Slide 2048
shortDescription: Swipe or use arrow keys to merge matching tiles and reach 2048 in this addictive neon puzzle game.

generation.notes: Neon-themed 2048 sliding tile puzzle. Features: 4x4 grid, keyboard/WASD/swipe controls, merge animations, localStorage best score, win/lose/continue overlays, responsive mobile-first layout, full light/dark theme support.
